Name: Emmett - Male Emily Mod for Content Patcher
Author: saltedcoffii
Description:
This mod is an adaptation of Girafarig's Emmett mod for content patcher. Content patcher mods are better for many reasons. See the dangers of using an XNB mod here: https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Using_XNB_mods

This mod edits the sprite and portrait of Emily and a few other things to make Emily male.

Please let me know about any bugs/errors.

Thank you so much for downloading! To add, drop into Mods folder. Make sure you have at least Stardew Valley 1.4.0, SMAPI 3.0.0, and Content Patcher 1.11.0 installed! Like the mod? Don't forget to endorse!
